2	
3	Checks your AI agent's records against what really happened, and fixes the tracing code when they disagree.
4	
5	[![CI](https://github.com/Jennycruzy/trueup/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Jennycruzy/trueup/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
6	
7	## For judges, start here
8	
9	- **[Live demo](https://trueup.38-49-216-59.sslip.io/demo)**: break a real AI bot yourself.
10	- **[Product site](https://trueup.38-49-216-59.sslip.io)**: what Trueup is, in one page.
11	- **neatlogs records, [before](https://app.neatlogs.com/traces/5322259c536eae9651b3f0819bfade85) and [after](https://app.neatlogs.com/traces/7304699be40a6194bafc2a45478bcd4f) the fix**: the demo page shows the same records step by step, for people without project access.
12	- **[How neatlogs caught and fixed Trueup's own mistakes](docs/built-with.md#neatlogs)**.
13	- **[neatlogs' daily email said 6.2%; the truth was 11.1%](docs/neatlogs-email.md)**: the tracing code recorded crashes as success.
14	- **Fixes sent upstream**: [Arize](https://github.com/Arize-ai/openinference/pull/4024) (reviewed by Arize's head of open source), [neatlogs](https://github.com/neatlogs/neatlogs/pull/207), [Traceloop](https://github.com/traceloop/openllmetry/pull/4610).
15	- **Entire**: [the fixer session](https://entire.io/gh/Jennycruzy/trueup/commit/79210a45418246ceb95e2990d1c003b5fbc7b3d9) (checkpoint `01M4M8M1GSQ2BM1RX2JKDJHPD6`), [full build history](https://entire.io/gh/Jennycruzy/trueup), [how each fix was made](fixes/openinference-run_status-openai-agents-top-level-span-status-ok/PROVENANCE.md).
16	- **[Our mistake with Entire](hackathon.md#what-entire-recorded-and-what-it-did-not-12-oct-observed)**: 20 updates were made in sessions Entire did not record; we said so, faked nothing, and moved all work back in.
17	- **[Business plan in cfo.ai](https://cfo.ai/s/kVKIburWzn09Baoy)**, also in [docs/business-plan.md](docs/business-plan.md).
18	- **[Fixes gallery](https://trueup.38-49-216-59.sslip.io/fixes)** · **[Build log](hackathon.md)**
19	
20	## The result
21	
22	| Real break | neatlogs before | After Trueup's fixes |
23	|---|---|---|
24	| Connection cut mid-reply | AI step SUCCESS | AI step ERROR, with the error |
25	| Agent run fails | Agent workflow SUCCESS | Agent workflow ERROR |
26	
27	**DISAGREE light: 2 → 0.** 40 normal calls, 0 false alarms. [Details](docs/witness-before-after.md).
28	
29	## Install
30	
31	Python 3.12 or newer.
32	
33	```
34	git clone https://github.com/Jennycruzy/trueup && pip install ./trueup
35	```
36	
37	## Quick start
38	
39	```python
40	import os
41	
42	import trueup.witness
43	trueup.witness.watch()          # once, at start-up, before neatlogs.init()
44	
45	import neatlogs
46	neatlogs.init(api_key=os.environ["NEATLOGS_API_KEY"], instrumentations=["openai"])
47	
48	with trueup.witness.run("order-1042") as run:   # one unit of work
49	    answer = agent.handle(order_id="1042")      # your own agent call
50	
51	print(run.disagreements)        # [] when the record matches what really happened
52	```
53	
54	When the record is wrong, Witness adds a red `TRACE DISAGREE` step to that same neatlogs record. It never breaks your app. `TRUEUP_WITNESS=0` turns it off.
55	
56	From the command line (Trueup also runs as an Entire command):

58	```

60	trueup audit examples/agent.py --library neatlogs   # check your own script against the practice AI server

63	## How it works

66	2. It compares that with the step neatlogs recorded.
67	3. On disagreement, it adds `TRACE DISAGREE`.
68	4. Trueup's lab finds the faulty tracing code, writes a fix and proves it.

# Trueup Witness

Checks your AI agent's records against what really happened, and fixes the tracing code when they disagree.

[![CI](https://github.com/Jennycruzy/trueup/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Jennycruzy/trueup/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

## For judges, start here

- **[Live demo](https://trueup.38-49-216-59.sslip.io/demo)**: break a real AI bot yourself.
- **[Product site](https://trueup.38-49-216-59.sslip.io)**: what Trueup is, in one page.
- **neatlogs records, [before](https://app.neatlogs.com/traces/5322259c536eae9651b3f0819bfade85) and [after](https://app.neatlogs.com/traces/7304699be40a6194bafc2a45478bcd4f) the fix**: the demo page shows the same records step by step, for people without project access.
- **[How neatlogs caught and fixed Trueup's own mistakes](docs/built-with.md#neatlogs)**.
- **[neatlogs' daily email said 6.2%; the truth was 11.1%](docs/neatlogs-email.md)**: the tracing code recorded crashes as success.
- **Fixes sent upstream**: [Arize](https://github.com/Arize-ai/openinference/pull/4024) (reviewed by Arize's head of open source), [neatlogs](https://github.com/neatlogs/neatlogs/pull/207), [Traceloop](https://github.com/traceloop/openllmetry/pull/4610).
- **Entire**: [the fixer session](https://entire.io/gh/Jennycruzy/trueup/commit/79210a45418246ceb95e2990d1c003b5fbc7b3d9) (checkpoint `01M4M8M1GSQ2BM1RX2JKDJHPD6`), [full build history](https://entire.io/gh/Jennycruzy/trueup), [how each fix was made](fixes/openinference-run_status-openai-agents-top-level-span-status-ok/PROVENANCE.md).
- **[Our mistake with Entire](hackathon.md#what-entire-recorded-and-what-it-did-not-12-oct-observed)**: 20 updates were made in sessions Entire did not record; we said so, faked nothing, and moved all work back in.
- **[Business plan in cfo.ai](https://cfo.ai/s/kVKIburWzn09Baoy)**, also in [docs/business-plan.md](docs/business-plan.md).
- **[Fixes gallery](https://trueup.38-49-216-59.sslip.io/fixes)** · **[Build log](hackathon.md)**

## The result

| Real break | neatlogs before | After Trueup's fixes |
|---|---|---|
| Connection cut mid-reply | AI step SUCCESS | AI step ERROR, with the error |
| Agent run fails | Agent workflow SUCCESS | Agent workflow ERROR |

**DISAGREE light: 2 → 0.** 40 normal calls, 0 false alarms. [Details](docs/witness-before-after.md).

## Install

Python 3.12 or newer.

```
git clone https://github.com/Jennycruzy/trueup && pip install ./trueup
```

## Quick start

```python
import os

import trueup.witness
trueup.witness.watch()          # once, at start-up, before neatlogs.init()

import neatlogs
neatlogs.init(api_key=os.environ["NEATLOGS_API_KEY"], instrumentations=["openai"])

with trueup.witness.run("order-1042") as run:   # one unit of work
    answer = agent.handle(order_id="1042")      # your own agent call

print(run.disagreements)        # [] when the record matches what really happened
```

When the record is wrong, Witness adds a red `TRACE DISAGREE` step to that same neatlogs record. It never breaks your app. `TRUEUP_WITNESS=0` turns it off.

From the command line (Trueup also runs as an Entire command):

```
entire trueup --help
trueup audit examples/agent.py --library neatlogs   # check your own script against the practice AI server
```

## How it works

1. Witness reads each AI call off the connection: status, errors, stream end.
2. It compares that with the step neatlogs recorded.
3. On disagreement, it adds `TRACE DISAGREE`.
4. Trueup's lab finds the faulty tracing code, writes a fix and proves it.

## Docs

[Getting started](docs/getting-started.md) · [How it works](docs/how-it-works.md) · [Built with](docs/built-with.md) · [Before and after](docs/witness-before-after.md) · [Known limits](docs/limits.md)

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. This session's requests use a 1-hour Anthropic prompt-cache TTL, so effectively every allowed delay (the runtime clamps to [60, 3600]) wakes up with your conversation context still cached. (If the session enters usage overage, later requests drop to the 5-minute TTL; don't try to track or preempt that — the guidance here stays the same.)

Match the delay to what you're actually waiting for:

- **Actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about** (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue): pick the delay from how fast that state actually changes. A CI run that takes ~8 minutes deserves one ~480s check, not eight 60s ones.
- **The long fallback heartbeat** (something else — a Monitor, a task notification — is the primary wake signal): 1200s+, so quiet wakeups stay rare.
- **Idle ticks with no specific signal to watch**: default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop still checks back regularly, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Don't think in cache windows — think about what you're actually waiting for.

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

# Trueup Witness

**Your dashboard said OK. Your agent crashed.** Trueup Witness checks your AI agent's records against what really happened, warns you inside neatlogs when they disagree, and fixes the tracing code that got it wrong.

### Why it matters

- **Proven live with real Claude calls:** 2 wrong records before Trueup's fixes, 0 after, and 0 false alarms in 40 normal calls.
- **neatlogs' own daily email said 6.2%** of our test runs failed; really 11.1% had crashed (test runs we crashed on purpose).
- **The fix we sent Arize was reviewed by their head of open source**, and neatlogs runs that same code for agents, so one fix repairs both.
- **Built with all three tools:** neatlogs recorded every run and caught our own agent's mistakes, Entire recorded how each fix was made, cfo.ai built the business plan from measured costs.

[![CI](https://github.com/Jennycruzy/trueup/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Jennycruzy/trueup/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

## For judges, start here

- **[Live demo](https://trueup.38-49-216-59.sslip.io/demo)**: break a real AI bot yourself.
- **[Product site](https://trueup.38-49-216-59.sslip.io)**: what Trueup is, in one page.
- **neatlogs records, [before](https://app.neatlogs.com/traces/5322259c536eae9651b3f0819bfade85) and [after](https://app.neatlogs.com/traces/7304699be40a6194bafc2a45478bcd4f) the fix**: the demo page shows the same records step by step, for people without project access.
- **[How neatlogs caught and fixed Trueup's own mistakes](docs/built-with.md#neatlogs)**.
- **[neatlogs' daily email said 6.2%; the truth was 11.1%](docs/neatlogs-email.md)**: the tracing code recorded crashes as success.
- **Fixes sent to the companies that make these tools**: [Arize](https://github.com/Arize-ai/openinference/pull/4024) (reviewed by Arize's head of open source), [neatlogs](https://github.com/neatlogs/neatlogs/pull/207), [Traceloop](https://github.com/traceloop/openllmetry/pull/4610).
- **Entire**: [the session where Trueup's agent wrote its first fixes](https://entire.io/gh/Jennycruzy/trueup/commit/79210a45418246ceb95e2990d1c003b5fbc7b3d9) (checkpoint `01M4M8M1GSQ2BM1RX2JKDJHPD6`), [full build history](https://entire.io/gh/Jennycruzy/trueup), [how each fix was made](fixes/openinference-run_status-openai-agents-top-level-span-status-ok/PROVENANCE.md).
- **[Our mistake with Entire](hackathon.md#what-entire-recorded-and-what-it-did-not-12-oct-observed)**: 20 updates were made in sessions Entire did not record; we said so, faked nothing, and moved all work back in.
- **[Business plan in cfo.ai](https://cfo.ai/s/kVKIburWzn09Baoy)**, also in [docs/business-plan.md](docs/business-plan.md).
- **[Fixes gallery](https://trueup.38-49-216-59.sslip.io/fixes)** · **[Build log](hackathon.md)**

## The result

| Real break | neatlogs before | After Trueup's fixes |
|---|---|---|
| Connection cut mid-reply | AI step SUCCESS | AI step ERROR, with the error |
| Agent run fails | Agent workflow SUCCESS | Agent workflow ERROR |

**DISAGREE light: 2 → 0.** 40 normal calls, 0 false alarms. [Details](docs/witness-before-after.md).

## Install

Python 3.12 or newer.

```
git clone https://github.com/Jennycruzy/trueup && pip install ./trueup
```

## Quick start

```python
import os

import trueup.witness
trueup.witness.watch()          # once, at start-up, before neatlogs.init()

import neatlogs
neatlogs.init(api_key=os.environ["NEATLOGS_API_KEY"], instrumentations=["openai"])

with trueup.witness.run("order-1042") as run:   # one job your agent does
    answer = agent.handle(order_id="1042")      # your own agent call

print(run.disagreements)        # [] when the record matches what really happened
```

When the record is wrong, Witness adds a red `TRACE DISAGREE` step to that same neatlogs record. It never breaks your app. `TRUEUP_WITNESS=0` turns it off.

From the project folder:

```
uv run entire trueup --help                               # Trueup as an Entire command
uv run trueup audit examples/agent.py --library neatlogs  # check your own script safely
```

## How it works

1. Witness reads each AI call off the connection: did the call fail, did the reply finish.
2. It compares that with the step neatlogs recorded.
3. On disagreement, it adds `TRACE DISAGREE`.
4. Trueup's test lab finds the faulty tracing code, writes a fix and proves it.

## Docs

[Getting started](docs/getting-started.md) · [How it works](docs/how-it-works.md) · [Built with](docs/built-with.md) · [Before and after](docs/witness-before-after.md) · [Known limits](docs/limits.md)

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)
